questions.stem: How is ModelOps positioned relative to MLOps?
options: As an unrelated discipline that replaces MLOps entirely
As the next stage of MLOps, focused on automating, retraining and maturing models on their own
As a subset of MLOps concerned only with model monitoring
As a manual review process that precedes MLOps
As a synonym for DevOps applied to databases
questions.explanation: There is a very thin line between the two, but ModelOps is described as the next stage of MLOps, where the focus shifts towards models automating, retraining and maturing on their own.

questions.stem: Which set of concerns is the MAIN focus of MLOps, as contrasted with ModelOps?
options: Model management, model monitoring and CI/CD
Life cycle management of decision models
questions.explanation: MLOps mainly focuses on model management, model monitoring and CI/CD, whereas ModelOps focuses on addressing and sharing AI performance with stakeholders.

questions.stem: ModelOps aims to share AI performance with stakeholders without needing the involvement of which team members?
options: Data Science and Machine Learning team members
questions.explanation: ModelOps mainly focuses on addressing and sharing AI performance to the stakeholders without the need of Data Science and Machine Learning team members.

questions.stem: MLOps focuses on operationalising ML models. What does ModelOps focus on operationalising instead?
questions.explanation: One of the listed differences: MLOps focuses on ML models operationalisation, whereas ModelOps focuses on decision models and AI operationalisation.

questions.stem: Whereas MLOps focuses on a continuous cycle of development, implementation and monitoring of models, ModelOps focuses on which of the following?
options: Writing model code for AI-enabled applications
Life cycle management and governance of models
questions.explanation: MLOps focuses on the continuous development, implementation and monitoring cycle, whereas ModelOps focuses on life cycle management and governance of models.

questions.stem: In ModelOps, AI transparency and the usage of KPIs are aimed at which audience?
questions.explanation: MLOps focuses on creating models for AI-enabled applications, whereas ModelOps focuses on AI transparency and the usage of KPIs by business users.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT listed as something models do on their own under ModelOps?
options: Write their own source code on their own
Extract business KPIs on their own
questions.explanation: In a nutshell, ModelOps supports AI capabilities where models run, retrain, deploy and extract business KPIs on their own. Writing their own source code is not among the listed capabilities.

questions.stem: As ModelOps matures, what happens to the involvement of Data Science in running models?
options: It increases because more models need supervision
It becomes less and less as models run on their own
It shifts entirely to external consultants
It is replaced by database administration
questions.explanation: ModelOps supports AI capabilities where the involvement of Data Science becomes less and less, as models run, retrain and deploy on their own.

questions.stem: Which of the following is the focus of MLOps rather than ModelOps?
questions.explanation: Creating models for AI-enabled applications is an MLOps focus; the other options describe ModelOps concerns.

questions.stem: Which statement best summarises the relationship between ModelOps and MLOps?
options: They are entirely separate fields with no overlap
MLOps is a later evolution of ModelOps
ModelOps only covers CI/CD pipelines for models
ModelOps applies only to deep learning models
There is a very thin line between them, with ModelOps building on MLOps towards self-managing models
questions.explanation: The two are separated by a very thin line: ModelOps is the next stage of MLOps, moving towards models that automate, retrain and mature on their own.
